source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For new Calendar querySelector and querySelectorAll calls, use a backtick-delimited selector string. This keeps double quotes available for attribute values in the selector and makes literal selectors easier to find with global search. This is a newer local style request, so migrate related lines when touched.
title: Use template quotes for query selector strings in Calendar code
